name: add_money_allocate_remainder
description: Add remainder-distributing allocate(n) to a Money value object; broken loses the indivisible remainder so parts don't sum back to the whole
prompts: Money in Money.java is a cents-backed value object (cents(), plus(), equals/hashCode). Add `List<Money> allocate(int n)` that splits the amount into n parts as evenly as possible WITHOUT losing money to rounding: the parts must sum back to the original exactly, and differ from each other by at most one cent. Distribute the indivisible remainder one cent at a time to the FIRST parts - so 100 cents into 3 parts is [34, 33, 33] (not [33, 33, 33], which loses a cent). Throw IllegalArgumentException for n <= 0. Do not add any dependency; keep the existing methods unchanged.
